changes.comment: ai-assist adapts a schema's constraint and annotation keywords on every tool and structured-output wire, with a keyword-capability table per format: passed where the provider documents the keyword, translated exactly where Gemini has an equivalent, and otherwise folded into the node's description as 'Constraints: ...'. OpenAI-format providers other than OpenAI and xAI, OpenAI fine-tuned models, and any descriptor of any format sent to a caller-supplied endpoint fold every keyword; a title a wire does not take is dropped. The validator still enforces each folded constraint.
